ui.cfg_ph: Config code (copy to save / paste to load)
ui.help_dmg: Damage = floor( max(1, (TotalAtk − 2/3×TotalDef) × DamageMag × (1 + 0.05×min(floor(TotalAtk/TotalDef),10))) × Rand(0.9,1.0) + RandInt(1,200) ). If the target holds a Ba stack the damage is ×0.7 and one stack is consumed. TotalAtk/TotalDef use buffed stats plus the matching elemental atk/def.
ui.help_buff: Buff/debuff amount = floor(BuffMag × caster's base stats), converted to the target's buff% and passed through decay: buffs decay 50% in +50%~+75% and 90% in +75%~+100% (cap +100%); debuffs decay 50% in −25%~−50% and 90% in −50%~−70% (floor −70%); elemental buffs never decay, range ±50%. Elemental BaseStats = (ATK+Sp.ATK)/2 or (DEF+Sp.DEF)/2.
ui.help_heal: Heal = floor(HealMag × caster's (DEF+Sp.DEF)/2). Heals can revive dead allies (capped at max HP); buffs carried by the heal card apply normally.
ui.help_marks: Mt: next attack ×1.2 (applies to every target of that attack card); An: next buff/debuff ×1.3; Et: next heal ×1.3; Ba: next hit taken ×0.7 (protects only the holder, consumed per hit taken). Max 3 kinds × 3 layers per player; gaining a 4th kind replaces the earliest-acquired one. A card triggering several effect types consumes one layer of each at once (damage + defense break uses Mt and An). Grants follow the skill text (self vs targets; target grants scale with target count and Range+1, never granted to enemies).
ui.help_death: Dead players cannot act and cannot be targeted by buffs, debuffs or damage; only heals can target and revive them. When a dead player's turn comes: with auto-revive ON they revive at 30% HP, otherwise the action is skipped. The battle ends the moment one side's front row is wiped.
ui.help_target: Damage/debuffs pick random living enemy front-row targets; heals/buffs pick random ally front-row targets (heals may include the dead). Target count is uniform between min~max; Range+1 adds one with the given probability (cap 4). Within one card the damage resolves first, then debuffs/buffs (it never benefits from its own defense break, but later allies do).
ui.help_flow: An action = pick an actor and one card. Damage/debuffs hit the enemy front row, heals/buffs the ally front row (attack cards self-heal / self-buff only). Multipliers reuse the deck builder pipeline (CHARM/ADX/theme/specialty/orders).
ui.help_up: Passive UP skills (damage/buff/heal UP) are rolled, not averaged: each action, every passive in the actor deck procs independently at 15%/22.5%/30% (+2% theme), adding coeff x1.5 on success. Range+1 fires at most once per action, P = 1 - prod(1-pi), adding one target (cap 4).
ui.help_eh: EH (off-attribute effect UP) and SD (off-attribute max range) are stateful: they trigger when the attribute of the card this player used previously differs from the current card (tracked during simulation). CT applies while the side is flagged disadvantaged.
ui.pcfg_note: The deck defines the proc pool for passive UP skills and Range+1; without a deck they never proc. CHARM/ADX/theme/specialty only affect this player.
ui.deck_none: no deck set (passive UP / Range+1 never proc)
ui.orders_note: Each side can have at most one active order. When disadvantage is checked, CT-type cards and disadvantage orders take effect.
ui.stack_note: Stack rules: each player holds at most 3 kinds, 3 layers each. Gaining a 4th kind replaces the earliest-acquired one (slot 1 is oldest). A trigger consumes 1 layer: damage = Mt, buff/debuff = An, heal = Et (one card can consume several kinds at once); Ba is consumed per hit taken and reduces only the hit received by its holder.
